heading: Preferences
intro: What is yours: how the panel reads and looks for you. It is kept in this browser; another browser starts from its own.
languageHelp: The language of the interface. Each name is written in its own language.
themeHelp: Light, dark, or the one your system uses. The palette and the logos are the operator's.
densityHelp: How tall a row of the message list is.
density_comfortable: Comfortable: two lines and a preview
remoteImagesHelp: Whether the images a message points at are loaded from the internet.
timeZoneHelp: The zone every date of the panel is printed in. The clock of the panel is UTC until you choose one.
pageSizeHelp: How many messages one page of the message list holds.
refreshHelp: How often the lists update on their own while a tab is in view. It is never off: a page left open keeps your session active. Fast never goes under 15 seconds, so the status counters and the queue, which already refresh every 15 seconds, do not change.
refreshDegraded: With the session's idle timeout this short, "Slow" is used as "Normal".
refresh_fast: Fast: up to twice as often
failed: The preferences could not be saved. Sign in again if the problem stays.
refused: Some values are not among the choices. Nothing was saved.
notInList: That is not one of the choices.
